evidence.coverage: NTSB aviation database (avall, 2008 to the download date): civil aviation accidents and selected incidents in the United States, its territories and international waters, plus foreign events involving US-registered, US-operated or US-manufactured aircraft in which the NTSB took part. It holds no military losses and almost no other foreign accidents, and records without coordinates cannot be matched. Wikidata: only accidents notable enough to have an item with coordinates within 10 km; far from complete anywhere. Outside the United States the absence of a record is weak evidence: most general-aviation and all military crashes abroad are in neither catalogue.
